scripts.test.tool: npm run lint && npm run build.dev && rimraf igo-test.db && NODE_ENV=test tape ./build/tool/*.test.js | tap-spec && NODE_ENV=test tape ./build/toolContext/*.test.js | tap-spec
scripts.test.layer: npm run lint && npm run build.dev && rimraf igo-test.db && NODE_ENV=test tape ./build/layer/*.test.js | tap-spec && NODE_ENV=test tape ./build/layerContext/*.test.js | tap-spec
